Standard: Provisions are in place to guard against accidental activation of emergency controls, as specified in MIL-STD-1472, Emergency Shutoff Controls and MIL-STD-1472, Prevention of Accidental Actuation paragraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review cockpit or crew station or control station layout drawings to verify that emergency controls are designed with provisions to prevent accidental activation as specified in MIL-STD- 1472, Emergency Shutoff Controls and MIL-STD-1472, Prevention of Accidental Actuation paragraphs. Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in a representative mockup or on the air vehicle that emergency controls have appropriate provisions to prevent accidental activation to include ingress and egress.
